name: Mitten Extracts | 3g Max Pro Disposable | Lavender Blueberry
description:
Sweet, smooth, and a little unexpected, Lavender Blueberry blends juicy berry flavor with a soft floral finish for a uniquely balanced experience. This 3G disposable delivers rich blueberry notes layered with subtle lavender undertones that create a calm, relaxing vibe from the first pull to the last. Flavorful, aromatic, and perfectly mellow, it’s a go-to for unwinding while enjoying something a little different.

Packed with 3G of Liquid Diamonds + Live Resin terpenes for a smooth, powerful experience that lasts. Fine-tune every hit with Flavor, Balance, or Clouds mode.
